comment: Professor Ho was a great professor for OB! She cares for her students and is easily accessible outside of class. Participation is key in this class, and if you make a good impression early on, you'll be set for this class. I wouldn't listen to bad reviews about her because she is a pretty fair professor and shows that she cares.

This class is a waste of time & easily the worst professor I've had. Grading is unclear & arguing your grade is pointless Lectures are illogical & feedback makes zero sense. Expectations are excessive because she wants to feel important. Do yourself a favor and never take her

Under no circumstances should you take MGMT 333. The course material is borderline non-existent and the professor has the IQ of a squirrel. She adds nothing of value assigns excessive busywork just to feel important and grades subjectively with no clear standards The entire cours exists for no reason. Take anything else I mean anything else.

You should definitely participate! If you do that often, she takes a quick liking to you. The course is not hard at all; you can adjust how many quizzes, exams, and projects count. The only disadvantage is that you'll have 3 group projects in the same group. It definitely is a course where you have to do a lot, but it is not hard.

Dr. Ho was a decent professor but certainly not my favorite. The other comments that she's a picky grader are very accurate but her biggest flaw is that there is almost no way to prepare for her final. Only half of the lecture slides are online and there's no study guide or notes to look to. If you take her make sure you take very detailed notes.

Its really important that you get on her good side from the beginning. Show her you care and it will help you on papers/projects. You never really know what your grade is which can be frustrating, but she is really sweet and tries to make the class as interesting as possible. I really enjoyed her

Dr. Ho is a fantastic professor. Shows that she cares a lot about her students (especially during the COVID-19 pandemic). Participate as much as possible. This is the best way to ensure success in her class. 10/10 would recommend. It was an interesting, fun, and relatively easy course

Professor Ho is pretty good. She really likes people who participate, so that's the way to get on her good side. She gives readying every night, but you only have 3 quizzes during the semester so it's worth it. There's also a semester-long group project that, I'm not going to lie, a fair amount of work. Her grading criteria can be elusive.
The worst professor I've had here, I honestly don't know how she still works here. She's unprofessional, rude, and just no helpful in general.

Dr. Ho is an extremely picky grader and it is hard to determine what she is looking for in assignments. I've met with her outside of class and she can be rude. If you miss class even once she is annoyed with you. Group project takes up a bulk of the semester and she is picky with presentations and papers. Quizzes are somewhat difficult

Participate in class. Pretty tough professor (likes structure) Lots of readings and 1 semester long group project with another smaller presentation about halfway through the semester. Tough grader (lots of writing on final)

Dr. Ho is truly passionate about teaching her students. It is obvious that she truly cares about their learning, and she does everything she can to give them opportunities to succeed. She treats students fairly and with respect, and she pushes them to work their hardest. She is by far, one of the best professors I've ever had the privilege of havin

No book, but there is a PDF reading for every class. Allowed the class to pick the grade %. In our case, 3 tests, each 10% (lowest dropped); 2 semester long projects (one can be done in a team, the other individual), each 20%; final 15%; and participation 15%. She didn't give us extra credit. Not a hard grader, but be ready for a lot of busy work.

The whole class revolves around an ongoing team project. So you will take a test with your team then individually. It's an interesting set up. But for the subject matter I think it worked well. There is also no textbook instead just practical PDFs and other online readings. There is also a lot of extra credit to boost your grade! So not too bad.

Now gives a time-consuming project that doesn't have anything to do with what is learned in class.  Lessons are entertaining, but don't really teach anything.  Seems nice at start of semester but ends up seeming self centered.  Doesn't really seem to care about her students, or take feedback seriously (despite the fact that she collects it often.

Really fun class!! You're placed on a team at the beginning of the semester and most of your in class work is done with your team. Professor Ho is helpful and responsive to students. She wants you to learn and enjoy the class.
AMAZING TEACHER! Definitely take her! She is extremely caring and helpful. She is always in her office for extra help. You learn a lot, but without tedious book-work or constant testing.
